content: {"reasoning":"The repeated CO-22 denials require coordination-of-benefits investigation, but the billing order is already correct and there is no secondary payer or identified claim-data error to fix. Another unchanged submission or a medical-necessity appeal would not address this denial, and authorization and peer-to-peer routes are unavailable. Because no available automated action can resolve the COB discrepancy, escalate rather than bill the patient beyond contractual responsibility or prematurely write off the balance.","action":"escalate"}
